title: Marigold Bow Hair Band
description: A cheerful crocheted hair band crowned with an oversized bow — snug enough to stay put, soft enough to forget. The marigold colorway pairs with everything in your wardrobe.

title: Midnight Witch Cat Keychain
description: A tiny black cat in a crocheted witch hat, finished with a ribbon and a sturdy brass keyring. A pocket-sized companion for bags, keys, and gift toppers.

title: Seaside Halter Top
description: A breezy summer halter with an open lace stitch along the hem and adjustable tie straps. Made for beach days and warm-weather layering.

title: Sunset Gradient Shawl
description: A featherweight triangular shawl that fades from amber to rose. Gossamer-soft mohair makes it drape like a whisper — elegant over anything.
care: Hand wash cold, block to dry

title: Woodland Textured Vest
description: A sleeveless vest in deep forest tones with a basketweave texture and ribbed trim. A cozy layer that works over shirts or dresses.

title: Chunky Hearth Throw
description: An oversized throw in super-bulky yarn with hand-tied fringe. Weighty, warm, and made for long evenings by the fire.

title: Boho Granny-Square Pillow
description: Vibrant granny squares pieced into a textured pillow cover with a hidden back closure. Includes a hypoallergenic insert.

title: Pineapple Lace Table Runner
description: A vintage-inspired pineapple lace runner with scalloped edges — an heirloom-in-the-making for dining tables and sideboards.
care: Hand wash, starch and block if desired

title: Trio of Woven Storage Baskets
description: Three nested baskets in natural, oat, and clay tones. Sturdy enough for blankets, toys, or plant pots — soft enough to fold flat.

title: Woodland Garland Bunting
description: Ten hand-stitched pennants in an earthy palette, strung on braided cotton cord. Instant warmth for nurseries, mantels, and celebrations.

title: Set of Six Marbled Coasters
description: Thick, absorbent coasters in marbled sage and cream. Weighted stitch pattern keeps them flat and durable through daily use.

title: Alpine Slouch Beanie
description: A softly slouchy beanie in brushed alpaca with a folded ribbed brim and a faux-fur pom. Warmth without bulk.
care: Hand wash cold, dry flat; detach pom

title: Everyday Market Tote
description: A structured, breathable tote with reinforced handles and a flat base that stands on its own. Carries a full market haul with room to spare.

title: Frostlace Fingerless Gloves
description: Delicate lace along the back of the hand, snug ribbing at the wrist. Keep your hands warm while your fingers stay free for phones, pages, and coffee cups.

title: Herringbone Infinity Scarf
description: A lofty infinity scarf in textured herringbone stitch, long enough for a generous double wrap. The kind of piece that becomes a signature.

title: Fern Bow Hair Clip
stitch: Tunisian crochet bow on snap base
description: A spring-green crocheted bow stitched over a no-slip metal snap. Light enough for fine hair, sturdy enough for every day.

title: Rainbow Tassel Keychain
description: A cheerful braided tassel keychain on a sturdy brass ring. Perfect as a gift topper or a bright spot on your bag.

title: Featherweight Hoop Earrings
description: Miniature crocheted hoops over hypoallergenic wires — dramatic enough to notice, light enough to forget you're wearing them.

title: Poinsettia Bloom Brooch
description: A festive layered bloom in berry red with a cream center and green accents — pin it to a coat, bag, or holiday sweater. Stitched in our studio, photographed on our worktable.

title: Lime Ruffle Scrunchie
stitch: Ruffle post-stitch band on elastic core
description: A high-shrunk lime ruffle that holds a ponytail without the crease. The textured post stitches give it volume that bounces back wash after wash.

title: Persimmon Fruit Charm
description: A tiny persimmon with a real leaf stem — sweet on a keyring, bag zipper, or desk shelf. Stuffing is hypoallergenic and surface-washable.

title: Lagoon & Berry Headband
description: A two-tone fitness headband in lagoon teal over berry red — the stitch gap lets it stretch to fit and snap back without slipping.
